comments.body:
Discovery Name: "Ancient Armament of the Siege"
Discovery Details: "Due to the arrival of enemy reinforcements during the Siege of Rhodes, it is said that the Demetrios' armies were forced to withdraw quickly, leaving behind many armaments, some of which were melted down and used as building materials for the Colossus."

Quest Name: Forgotten Armaments
Skill Required: R6 Search, R8 Archaeology, Greek

Quest Details: During the 'Siege of Rhodes' due to Demetrius's sudden retreat, a lot of armaments were left behind. For anecdotes regarding one of the Seven Wonders of the World, perhaps you may be able to investigate about them in detail at the Archives in Athens.

Quest obtained with 10-star clue "A Record of the Siege 5" from new Treasure Hunt Legend Regarding an Old Map
